nina: quick thought — separate "occupancy" from residency. occupancy = logical interest score used for scheduling; residency = physical pinned state. decoupling lets us make promote/demote decisions based on occupancy trends without thrashing physical memory.

omar: sounds promising. how do you compute occupancy? rolling window of accesses?

nina: yes. occupancy = EWMA(hit_count, alpha=0.3) * size_weight. update per page on hit. keep small integer score to reduce memory.

paul: how do we prevent a noisy tenant filling occupancy and blocking others?

nina: per-tenant occupancy budget. each tenant has occupancy_quota; if exceeded, new page hits only increase occupancy at reduced rate. also global reclaim watermark to force compaction/demote when overall occupancy > cap.

rita: pseudocode please for the core loop.

nina: ```
on_hit(page, tenant, tokens):
  inc = min(1.0, tokens/64.0)
  inc *= tenant.scale_factor
  page.occ = page.occ*(1-alpha) + inc*alpha
periodic_eval(page):
  if page.occ > promote_thresh and not resident: promote(page)
  if page.occ < demote_thresh and resident and page.age > min_age: demote(page)
```

omar: where does fragmentation/compaction fit in? frequent demotes cause scatter on host, so we should emit compaction_hint when demote_rate spikes. compaction triggered only when benefit > cost estimate.

paul: streaming detection still needed — high uniqueness ratio over window should mark flow as streaming and apply stream_multiplier=0.2 to occupancy increments.

rita: metrics: `page.occ_p50_p95`, `tenant.occ_usage`, `global.occupancy`, `promote_rate`, `demote_rate`, `compaction_hints_emitted`. add `stream_flow_count`.

ci-bot: experiment created: config: `occ.alpha=0.3`, `occ.promote=4.0`, `occ.demote=1.0`, `tenant.occ_quota=1000`, rollout=15% clusters.

nina: rollout plan: canary on non-critical infra 1 week, then 30% for 2 weeks. smoke tests: synthetic locality, long stream, multi-tenant hammer. rollback knobs: set occ.promote=999 or disable occupancy eval.

omar: one more ask: expose an API hint `buf.occupancy_hint(level=0..3)` so model runners can mark important pages. low level for ephemeral prefix, high for core weights.

paul: agree. also add a simulation harness to validate eviction/churn tradeoffs before rollout.

rita: I'll draft RFC addendum with formulas, knobs, telemetry, and test plan. assigning to @rita.
